headline: IIRM Holdings Q2FY27: Consolidated PAT up 23% YoY
summary: IIRM Holdings India Limited reported a 23% YoY rise in consolidated net profit to ₹515 lakh for Q2FY27. Standalone revenue grew 141% YoY, driven by consultancy services.

headline: Jagatjit Industries Q2FY27: Loss narrows, ethanol drives revenue
summary: Jagatjit Industries reported a standalone net loss of ₹392 lakh for Q2FY27, narrowing from ₹2,787 lakh a year ago. Revenue surged to ₹1,922 lakh as ethanol operations scaled up.

headline: CSML H1FY27 profit rises 27% to ₹998 lakh
summary: Complete Sports and Management India Limited reported a 27.1% YoY rise in H1FY27 PAT to ₹998 lakh, driven by 52.1% revenue growth to ₹6,328 lakh.

headline: Davangere Sugar Q2FY27 Results: Standalone Loss Widens
summary: Davangere Sugar Company reported a standalone net loss of ₹538.73 lakh in Q2FY27, widening from a profit of ₹262.99 lakh in the year-ago quarter.

headline: Fusion CX to acquire three German BPO firms
summary: Fusion CX Ltd's UK subsidiary signed an SPA to acquire 100% of three German BPO entities for EUR 2 million upfront plus earn-out, expanding its European footprint.

headline: RBI approves Pratap Singh as Fino Bank MD & CEO
summary: RBI has approved Pratap Singh's appointment as MD & CEO of Fino Payments Bank for three years, effective November 27, 2026. The move awaits shareholder ratification.

headline: TVS Motor expands Brazil ops with new store
summary: TVS Motor Company expands Brazil operations with a new São Paulo flagship store and increased production capacity to 130,000 units by 2027.

headline: Godrej Properties acquires 31-acre land in Indore
summary: Godrej Properties adds a ~31-acre parcel in Indore for a plotted development with ~0.7 million sq ft saleable area, marking its third project in the city.

headline: Stocks to Watch: Manappuram, Hitachi, IRCTC in focus
summary: Manappuram Finance surges on 223% profit jump. Hitachi Energy slips despite strong earnings. IRCTC retreats on exceptional item hit.

headline: Page Industries targets double-digit FY27 volume growth
summary: Page Industries management confirms expectation of double-digit volume growth for FY27. H1 growth is mid-single digits, requiring ~14% in H2. EBITDA margins projected at 19-21%.

headline: Manappuram Finance eyes 17% gold loan yield stabilisation
summary: Manappuram Finance expects gold loan yields to stabilise around 17% within three years, with current gross yields for EMI and bullet payments ranging from 17.5% to 18.5% among major competitors.

headline: Dilip Buildcon targets 57 million tonne coal output by FY29
summary: Dilip Buildcon targets 27 million tonne coal output at Siarmal and 7 million tonne at Pachhwara in FY27, with a 57 million tonne annual goal by FY29 yielding ₹1,000 crore in yearly operating cash flow.

headline: CLSA upgrades Manappuram Finance to Outperform
summary: CLSA upgrades Manappuram Finance to Outperform with a target price of ₹370. Q2FY27 standalone PAT beat estimates by 3%, gold loan book grew 6% QoQ, and FY27-29 PAT estimates raised by 1-6%.

headline: JPMorgan keeps NMDC at Underweight, target ₹64
summary: JPMorgan maintains Underweight on NMDC with a target price of ₹64. Q2 EBITDA and PAT missed estimates by 14% and 8%, respectively, with expenses per tonne up ~13% YoY.

headline: Adani Energy completes Intellismart acquisition
summary: Adani Energy Solutions has acquired 100% equity in Intellismart Infrastructure from NIIF and EESL. The deal closed on November 12, 2026, following antitrust approval.

headline: Caplin Point targets 20-21% PAT margin
summary: Caplin Point Laboratories aims for 20-21% profit after tax margins, targeting 25-26% annually. COL-II facility completion is expected by August 2027, with significant revenue anticipated in FY28-29.

headline: India 10-year bond yield rises to 7.2887%
summary: India's 10-year benchmark government bond yield rose to 7.2887% from the previous close of 7.2467%, reflecting an upward move in sovereign debt yields.

headline: Lakshmi Electrical Control Systems seeks shareholder approval for new directors
summary: Lakshmi Electrical Control Systems Ltd initiates postal ballot for appointing Vedhanth Senthilkumar and Thiagarajan Arumugam as Whole-time Directors. E-voting opens November 14, 2026.

headline: Raymond Lifestyle promoter rectifies pledge disclosure
summary: J.K. Investors (Bombay) Limited corrected its September 2026 pledge disclosure for Raymond Lifestyle, revising encumbered shares to 99.40 lakh (16.32% of capital).

headline: Telge Projects Q2FY27 profit jumps 226% to ₹83.55 lakh
summary: Telge Projects reported a 61.4% YoY revenue rise and 226% PAT growth in Q2FY27. Consolidated revenue more than doubled, driven by strong operational performance.

headline: Uniroyal Industries Q2FY27 Results
summary: Uniroyal Industries reports consolidated net profit of ₹10.21 lakh for Q2FY27, turning profitable from a loss. Standalone revenue fell to ₹330.95 lakh.

headline: NRB Bearings promoter releases 3 lakh pledged shares
summary: Harshbeena Sahney Zaveri released 3,00,000 pledged shares of NRB Bearings following loan prepayment. Remaining encumbered holding stands at 11,00,000 shares.

headline: Sona BLW to host investor meetings Nov 17-19
summary: Sona BLW Precision Forgings will participate in three investor forums in Mumbai and virtually from November 17 to 19, 2026.

headline: Salzer Electronics delays Saudi Arabia facility to April 2027
summary: Salzer Electronics has pushed back the opening of its Saudi Arabia facility to April 2027, citing the ongoing Middle East conflict as the reason for the delay.

headline: HGM Q2FY27 Results: Consolidated loss widens
summary: HandsOn Global Management reported a consolidated net loss of ₹255.15 lakh for Q2FY27, a sharp reversal from the ₹49.54 lakh profit in Q2FY26. Revenue from operations declined 45.3% YoY.

headline: Kopran promoter group raises stake to 6.36%
summary: Sarvamangal Mercantile Company Ltd, part of the Kopran Ltd promoter group, increased its holding to 6.36% after acquiring 1.70 lakh shares in the open market.

headline: Shriram Properties receives reclassification request
summary: Shriram Group Executives Welfare Trust seeks reclassification from Promoter to Public category after divesting its stake in Shriram Properties Holdings Private Limited.

headline: City Union Bank appoints Sankaran G as ED
summary: City Union Bank has co-opted Sankaran G as an Additional Director and Executive Director for three years, effective November 13, 2026.

headline: Tata Sons declines Noel Tata's recording request
summary: Tata Sons rejected Noel Tata's request for the September 17 board meeting recording. Advocate HP Ranina notes no legal obligation exists, though voluntary sharing is advised.

headline: Aegis Logistics to host investor meet on Nov 18
summary: Aegis Logistics Limited will host an analyst and institutional investor meet in Mumbai on November 18, 2026. The company confirmed no unpublished price sensitive information will be discussed.

headline: Satin Creditcare to host analyst meet Dec 14
summary: Satin Creditcare Network Ltd will hold an analyst and investor meet in Mumbai on December 14, 2026. Management will discuss strategy and future outlook.

headline: Venus Pipes posts record Q2 revenue, wins data center order
summary: Venus Pipes & Tubes Ltd reported highest-ever quarterly revenue of ₹361.1 crore, up 23.9% YoY. The company secured a ₹29 crore order from a data center client and raised ₹372 crore via preferential allotment to reduce debt.

headline: Pajson Agro posts 23% revenue growth in H1FY27
summary: Pajson Agro India reported a 23% YoY rise in total income to ₹145 crore for H1FY27. The company also announced the acquisition of Pacific Global FZCO to expand global processing capacity.

headline: DCX Systems secures orders worth ₹23.06 crore
summary: DCX Systems secured orders totalling ₹23.06 crore for cable and wire harness assemblies. Its subsidiary also obtained orders worth ₹2.47 crore for printed circuit board assemblies.

headline: SpiceJet board to consider fresh capital raise
summary: SpiceJet Limited board meeting scheduled for November 18, 2026, to approve raising fresh capital via preferential issue or QIP. Trading window closed until further notice.

headline: Park Medi World Q2 results: profit falls, revenue rises
summary: Park Medi World reported a consolidated net profit of 521M rupees in Q2, down from 736M rupees YoY, while revenue rose to 5.1B rupees from 4.1B rupees in the same period last year.

headline: IRB Infra files earnings call transcript
summary: IRB Infrastructure Developers filed the transcript of its earnings call held on November 6, 2026, with BSE and NSE under Regulation 30.

headline: Century Plyboards promoter buys shares
summary: Sajjan Bhajanka acquired 66,868 shares in open market transactions on Nov 9 and 11, 2026. His holding rose to 10.93% of total share capital.

headline: Axis MF cuts Arvind Fashions stake to 2.91%
summary: Axis Mutual Fund disposed 0.32% equity shares in Arvind Fashions, reducing its total holding to 2.91%. The sale was executed in the open market by Axis Flexi Cap Fund.

headline: Poly Medicure to host investor meet on Nov 18
summary: Poly Medicure Limited officials will participate in the Avendus Spark INDX Annual Investor Conference in Mumbai on November 18, 2026.

headline: Thriveni revises pledge disclosures for Lloyds Engineering
summary: Thriveni Earthmovers filed revised SEBI disclosures for Lloyds Engineering Works, correcting missing dates and modes in pledge creation and release filings.

headline: India bans lithium battery black mass exports
summary: India prohibits lithium-ion battery black mass exports to boost domestic recycling. Eco Recycling Ltd, eligible for ₹1,500 crore scheme, sees improved feedstock access.

headline: Danlaw Q2FY27 PAT jumps 42% YoY to ₹783 lakh
summary: Danlaw Technologies India Limited reported a 42.3% YoY rise in net profit for Q2FY27, driven by strong revenue growth and improved operating margins.

headline: Photon Capital turns profitable in Q2FY27
summary: Inference Platforms Ltd (formerly Photon Capital Advisors) reported a net profit of ₹63.19 lakh for Q2FY27, reversing a loss. Revenue from operations surged to ₹113 lakh.

headline: Fabino promoter Aditya Jain exits 56.82% stake
summary: Aditya Mahavir Jain disposed of his entire 11,93,200 share holding in Fabino Enterprises via off-market deal. The transaction transfers 56.82% equity to new acquirers.

headline: LIC cuts HUDCO stake to 6.88% via market sale
summary: LIC sold 4.05 crore HUDCO shares, reducing its holding from 8.90% to 6.88%. The transaction, executed between Oct 2023 and Nov 2026, was a market sale.

headline: Laser Power & Infra gets exchange nod for promoter reclassification
summary: Laser Power & Infra Ltd received approval from NSE and BSE to reclassify Chaitak Sales and Daimler Industries from Promoter Group to Public under SEBI regulations.

headline: KMC Speciality Q2 net profit rises 51% YoY
summary: KMC Speciality Hospitals reported a 51% YoY rise in Q2 net profit to ₹163 million, driven by 24% revenue growth. EBITDA margin contracted slightly.

headline: Gujarat Fluorochemicals incorporates new EV minerals subsidiary
summary: Gujarat Fluorochemicals Ltd incorporated GFCL EV Critical Minerals Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of its material subsidiary GFCL EV Products Ltd, on November 12, 2026.

headline: Oil India estimates FY28 capex at ₹60 billion
summary: Oil India estimates its FY28 capital expenditure at ₹60 billion, which is expected to be lower than FY27 levels, signalling a planned reduction in investment outlay.

headline: Airtel's Mittal sees 100-150M subscribers from $30 ARPU market
summary: Bharti Airtel chairman Sunil Bharti Mittal predicts 100-150 million new subscribers will come from the $30 ARPU market segment, not the $3 ARPU market.

headline: P N Gadgil Jewellers posts 14% festive sales growth
summary: P N Gadgil Jewellers recorded ₹689 crore in Diwali sales for FY27, up 14% YoY. Silver sales surged 24%, while studded jewellery contributed 17.2% of total revenue.

headline: Manoj Vaibhav Gems Q2 net profit rises 12.5% YoY
summary: Manoj Vaibhav Gems reported a 12.5% YoY rise in standalone net profit to ₹357 million, despite EBITDA margin contraction to 6.51%.

headline: Polylink Polymers Q2FY27 net profit down 50% QoQ
summary: Polylink Polymers reported a standalone net profit of ₹20.81 lakh for Q2FY27, marking a 50.4% decline from the previous quarter despite revenue growth.
